name: invoice
description: Resolve, generate, approve, send, and follow up on a client invoice.
acceptance: Invoice numbers reconcile with time tracking.
The PDF uses the client brand.
No invoice is sent without approval.

steps.prompt: Resolve the client, period, scope, hours, and line items by voice.
acceptance: Client, period, scope, and line items are confirmed.

steps.prompt: Create the branded invoice PDF with invoiceDocument, or the requested spreadsheet.
acceptance: The invoice PDF matches the client brand and reconciles with time tracking.

steps.prompt: Prepare the configured email or WhatsApp message; do not send until the payload is approved.
acceptance: The exact send payload is shown before sending.

steps.prompt: Schedule +7, +14, and +21 day follow-ups using overdue invoice data and client-language reminder copy.
